namespace PubAC10
def zipAdd : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => (x + y) :: zipAdd xs ys
  | _, _ => []
def sumList : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + sumList xs
theorem sumList_append (xs ys : List Nat) : sumList (xs ++ ys) = sumList xs + sumList ys := by sorry
theorem zipAdd_zero_sides (row : List Nat) : sumList (zipAdd (0 :: row) (row ++ [0])) = 2 * sumList row := by sorry
end PubAC10
